versions.name: RXV2-0.9.185-voltage-soc
versions.notes: Battery % is now a resting-voltage state-of-charge from the per-cell voltage, instead of the flight-controllers mAh-based figure (which reads ~full on the bench because little current has been drawn - e.g. 98% at 3.75 V/cell). Standard resting-LiPo curve: 3.75 V ~25%, 3.80 V ~40%, 4.20 V 100%. Note that it reads low under load.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.184-per-cell
versions.notes: Battery status now shows PER-CELL voltage (large), with the cell count auto-detected from the pack voltage (ceil(V/4.3) - reliable for storage or charged packs of any size). Also shows cell count (e.g. 4S), pack voltage and %. Colour cue: green at/above storage, amber getting low, red very low. Reminder to store at 3.80 V/cell.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.183-blackbox-status
versions.notes: Adds a live Status panel to the Black box page: battery VOLTAGE (large), pack %, current, mAh used, head speed, ESC temp and flight mode - all from the flight-controller telemetry, updating every 2s. Handy for a quick battery check with the model powered (the transmitter does not need to be on; just have WiFi up).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.182-restore-rates
versions.notes: Makes the transmitter backup/restore of Rates+Advanced behave like V1. When the TX restores both together it sends the basic batch AND the advanced batch; the receiver now writes BOTH (so the basic rates are actually restored), while an advanced-only EDIT still preserves the basic rates (no zeroing). Matches V1 exactly: basic is written on the combined save only when the TX actually sent it. PIDs, advanced PID and governor-profile restore were already full writes.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.181-sticky-block
versions.notes: Further reduces occasional all-zeros when reading params from the transmitter (seen most on governor profile). The receiver now keeps streaming the last-read block's cached values to the TX even after the read window ends - so lingering on a screen past the window, or a dropped request, shows the last good values (stale at worst) instead of zeros. FC re-polling still stops when the window closes, so no extra MSP load.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.180-fc-keepalive
versions.notes: Fixes the web UI losing its Rotorflight options after the transmitter is used then switched off (until a reboot). On CRSF, signal loss detaches the output UART (so the FC sees the dropout) - but that also kills the FC RX line, so MSP stops and the flight-controller detection times out. The receiver now keeps the UART attached whenever WiFi is up (bench/config mode, where there is no transmitter by design and you need MSP). In-flight failsafe is unchanged - WiFi is off in flight.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.179-gov-global
versions.notes: Fixes the governor GLOBAL (config) screen showing nothing on the transmitter. The receiver was discarding the whole MSP_GOVERNOR_CONFIG response unless it was at least 42 bytes, but RF 2.3 can report a different length - and only bytes up to 32 are actually read (the bypass curve at 33+ is just preserved on write). Now accepts any response reaching byte 32, so the global settings populate.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.178-tx-governor
versions.notes: Adds GOVERNOR editing from the transmitter (profile + config), RF 2.3+ only. Profile via MSP_GOVERNOR_PROFILE/SET (148/149); config via MSP_GOVERNOR_CONFIG/SET (142/143) followed by an FC reboot so it takes effect (like V1). Completes full Rotorflight parity from the handset: rates, advanced rates, PIDs, advanced PIDs, governor - all readable and writable from the TX as well as the iPhone.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.177-adv-pid
versions.notes: Adds ADVANCED PID editing from the transmitter (read + write): the full Dynamics/bandwidth/cutoff/limit set (26 values) via MSP_PID_PROFILE / MSP_SET_PID_PROFILE, mapped through the scattered profile offsets. Read-modify-write preserves untouched fields. That is rates, advanced rates, PIDs and advanced PIDs all editable from the handset - governor next.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.176-timing
versions.notes: Reduces the occasional all-zeros when reading params from the transmitter. Removed the post-write cache blanking (the re-poll refreshes the saved values anyway), tightened the FC re-poll to ~50ms (was 80ms, matching V1), and shortened the stuck-fetch retry from 400ms to 250ms. Any remaining rare zeros are a dropped request packet from the TX (re-trigger to fix).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.175-adv-preserve
versions.notes: Fix: saving ADVANCED rates from the transmitter no longer zeroes that bank's BASIC rates (and vice-versa). Each rates screen now writes only its own fields via read-modify-write; the other fields are preserved from the FC. Previously the advanced save also wrote the basic-rate fields from staged values that could be zero (e.g. a lost batch packet), clobbering the bank.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.174-tx-pids
versions.notes: Adds PID editing from the transmitter (read + write). 17 PID values (P/I/D/FF per axis, boosts, HSI offsets) read via MSP_PID and written via MSP_SET_PID, using the same continuous-re-poll engine as rates. Governor next.
